dsp GenNoiseFireStillNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.0 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := select(gt(nz, 0.996), 1.0, crack * 0.97)
    set crack := crackA
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (1500.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.6850

noiseFireStillWide.source:
dsp GenNoiseFireStillWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.0 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := select(gt(nz, 0.996), 1.0, crack * 0.97)
    set crack := crackA
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (1500.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 1.4
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 1.0 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.7289

dsp GenNoiseFireGustyWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.6 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.25
    let crackA := select(gt(nz, 0.996), 1.0, crack * 0.97)
    set crack := crackA
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (1500.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 1.4
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 1.0 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.5336

dsp GenNoiseHissStillNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.0 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (9000.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.4679

noiseHissGustyNarrow.source:
dsp GenNoiseHissGustyNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.6 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.25
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (9000.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.3412

noiseStormStillWide.source:
dsp GenNoiseStormStillWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.0 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (300.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 1.4
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 1.0 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 1.3395

dsp GenNoiseStormSlowNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.13 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (300.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.6810

noiseStormGustyWide.source:
dsp GenNoiseStormGustyWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.6 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.25
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (300.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 1.4
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 1.0 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.8005

noiseRumbleSlowNarrow.source:
dsp GenNoiseRumbleSlowNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.13 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (90.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.8724

dsp GenNoiseRumbleSlowWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.13 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (90.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 1.4
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 1.0 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 1.2014

dsp GenChipPulse12BlipSlideDown where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + slA * 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.12 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6537

dsp GenChipPulse12NoteVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.002 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.012
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.12 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6444

dsp GenChipPulse12SwellPlain where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.12 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6446

dsp GenChipPulse12SwellSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.12 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6446

dsp GenChipPulse25BlipVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.012
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.25 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6537

dsp GenChipPulse25BlipSlideDown where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + slA * 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.25 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6537

chipPulse25NoteSlideUp.source:
dsp GenChipPulse25NoteSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.002 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let w := select(lt(ph, 0.25 + colour * 0.1), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.6444
